title: Video2STL: Grounding VLM-Generated Temporal Specifications for Robot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37519v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video-based policy learning is particularly promising, as it illustrates target behaviors without requiring action annotations or embodiment-matched demonstrations. A central challenge is deciding what information should be transferred from the video to the robot. Existing approaches commonly convert visual observations into scalar similarity or value signals, or ask foundation models to directly generate reward code. These approaches can make the temporal structure of a task difficult to inspect, ground, and reuse. We present Video2STL, a framework that converts observation-only videos into parametric Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and uses the resulting formal representation for robot learning. A vision-language model extracts an embodiment-independent semantic event trace and constructs a bank of symbolic temporal specifications. translated_title: Video2STL：将视觉语言模型生成的时序规范落地于机器人学习
translated_abstract: 基于视频的策略学习尤其具有前景，因为它能够展示目标行为，而无需动作标注或与机器人本体匹配的演示。一个核心挑战在于决定应从视频向机器人传递哪些信息。现有方法通常将视觉观测转换为标量相似度或价值信号，或者让基础模型直接生成奖励代码。这些方法可能导致任务的时序结构难以检查、落地（ground）和复用。我们提出Video2STL，这是一个将仅含观测的视频转换为参数化信号时序逻辑（STL）规范，并利用所得形式化表示进行机器人学习的框架。视觉语言模型提取与机器人本体无关的语义事件轨迹，并构建一个符号化时序规范库。该模型负责确定任务结构，而数值谓词阈值与时序边界（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: Video2STL提出将仅含观测的视频通过视觉语言模型转换为参数化的信号时序逻辑（STL）形式化规范，为机器人学习提供可检查、可落地、可复用的任务时序结构表示。
en_tdlr: Video2STL converts observation-only videos into parametric Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications via a vision-language model, providing an inspectable, groundable, and reusable formal temporal representation for robot learning.
